market.title: For a good cat
market.summary_raw:
Ella Lyon-Caggiano-Stirling, a runt of a litter that grew to be head mouse-catcher in six separate households, died today. She was 16.

She died at Morristown Animal Hospital, her owner by her side. The cause was progressive kidney disease.

Ella seemed to live a life against the odds. She might not have survived her kitten years had a worker at KittyKind in Union Square not sweet-talked a young couple who wanted a second cat. They were forever grateful.

market.title: My tattoo
market.summary_raw:
About 20 years ago, a friend of mine stabbed me with a pencil. I was reaching for something on his desk and he went to swat my hand away, not realizing he was holding a pencil. The tip snapped off in my finger, I had to go to the hospital to get it removed. He felt terrible, and feigned illness to come to the nurse and check on me. When I got it removed the doctor told me “you’ll be the first of your friends to have a tattoo.”
